answer:
**Build a Reinforced Iron Plate (RIP) line next, and use it to finish Space Elevator phase 1.**

**Why RIP**
- Phase 1 needs 50 Smart Plating. Each one takes a Reinforced Iron Plate and a Rotor. That means 50 RIP and 50 Rotors, and nothing automates RIP yet.
- Rotors and screws are already covered. You have 87 Rotors and about 12,000 screws in storage, so the only missing link is plates.
- Your two close iron nodes are impure and already mined, at 60 ore/min total. That ore already feeds your rod and screw lines, so leave it alone.

**Where**
- Use the normal-purity iron cluster to the NW, about 240–285 m out, on the edge of the Grass Fields.
- The nodes are at (-491, 2317), (-516, 2294) and (-541, 2294).
- Mine two of them with Miner Mk.1s and keep the third spare for later.

**Chain**
- This chain makes about 10 RIP/min. I scaled the tool's 10/min chain down because screws come from storage.
  - 2 Miner Mk.1 on normal nodes.
  - 3 Smelters (Iron Ingot).
  - 3 Constructors (Iron Plate).
  - 2 Assemblers (Reinforced Iron Plate).
- Hand-feed or belt screws from a Storage Container. 50 RIP needs 600 screws, so your stock covers this many times over.
- You don't need new screw or rod lines. Your existing ones cover it.
- Add a Smart Plating Assembler after it, fed by RIP and your stored Rotors.

**Timeline and cost**
- About 5 minutes of running makes the 50 RIP. Smart Plating follows quickly.
- The tool's build cost for the full chain (with screw and rod lines) is 62 RIP. Mine is smaller. Check the RIP you can hand-craft before you start. If you're short, build the Assemblers first and bootstrap from there.
- Power is fine. You have about 514 MW of headroom on paper. Check that your Biomass Burners are actually fuelled.

I haven't issued a work order yet. Say the word and I'll issue the full order with exact belt, splitter and pole counts. I'll run a material check first.

Your next iron build is a **Reinforced Iron Plate (RIP) line**. I've issued it as WO-001, "Reinforced Plate Works", and it's ready to start.

**Why this one**
- The Space Elevator needs 50 Smart Plating, and that gates Tier 4. Smart Plating is 1 RIP plus 1 Rotor.
- You already have 87 Rotors and about 12k Screws in storage. The only missing input is iron plate, and nothing makes plates or RIP yet.

- **Site:** NW Grass Fields, about 240 m from you at around (-510, 2310). Three normal iron nodes sit together there: (-491, 2317), (-516, 2294) and (-541, 2294).

The 50 RIP for Smart Plating take only a few minutes of output. After that, the line feeds Modular Frames and the rest of Tier 4.

**Power:** The line draws roughly 100 MW. You have headroom on paper, but check that your Biomass Burners are fuelled.

arguments.title: Reinforced Iron Plate Line
arguments.goal: Automate Reinforced Iron Plates and use them to build the 50 Smart Plating that unlock Space Elevator phase 1.
arguments.objective: Mine the three normal iron nodes NW of base, smelt to ingots, press into Iron Plates, and assemble Reinforced Iron Plates. Feed them with your existing Screw output. Run two Assemblers making Smart Plating from the RIP and your stored Rotors.
arguments.successCondition: Reinforced Iron Plates are produced steadily at about 20/min and 50 Smart Plating are delivered to the Space Elevator.
arguments.strategicSignificance: Reinforced Iron Plate is the missing link (nothing makes it or Iron Plates yet), and it gates the Space Elevator, Tier 4 and every later frame recipe.

buildSteps.title: Mine the ore
buildSteps.description: Place a Miner Mk.1 on each of the three normal iron nodes at (-490,2317), (-516,2294) and (-541,2294). Give each its own belt to the smelter block. Mk.1 belts carry 60/min and each miner makes 60/min, so no merging is needed.

buildables.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.1
buildables.notes: Rough count; run each miner's own belt to the smelter block

buildSteps.title: Smelt ingots
buildSteps.description: Six smelters take 180 ore/min and give 180 ingots/min. Each smelter has its own input belt and an output belt.

buildSteps.title: Press Iron Plates
buildSteps.description: Six constructors turn the ingots into 120 plates/min. Run the plates on a Mk.2 belt.

buildSteps.title: Assemble Reinforced Iron Plates
buildSteps.description: Four assemblers each need 30 plates/min and 60 screws/min. Split the plates four ways. Tap your existing Screw constructors (240/min) with a splitter and run that screw belt here. Merge the RIP output onto one belt into a Storage Container.

buildSteps.title: Build Smart Plating
buildSteps.description: Two assemblers take RIP from the line plus Rotors, with 87 in storage and 8/min made. Hand-feed or belt the Rotors. Send the output to a container beside the Space Elevator.

locationRecommendation.summary: Build the smelting and press block between the base and the normal iron nodes, in the NW Grass Fields.

notes: Your two impure iron nodes next to the HUB are already tapped and feed the rod and screw lines, so leave them alone.
Power: the new block draws roughly 125 MW, and you have about 500 MW of headroom. Check that your Biomass Burners are fuelled.
The Smart Plating needs only 50 RIP. Once the Elevator is done, keep the RIP line running for Modular Frames and Heavy Frames.

toolCalls.result: Issued WO-001: "Reinforced Iron Plate Line" (state: new). Tell the pioneer it is ready to start.

answer:
Build a **Reinforced Iron Plate (RIP) line**. I've issued it as WO-001, and it's ready to start.

**Why this one:**
- Nothing in your base makes Iron Plates or RIP yet. Those are the two gaps in the Smart Plating chain.
- You need 50 Smart Plating to finish Space Elevator phase 1 and unlock Tier 4.
- The other inputs are already covered. You have about 12k Screws in storage and 240/min coming in. You also have 87 Rotors, plus 8/min being made.

**What it builds:**
- **Mining:** 3 Miner Mk.1 on the normal iron nodes NW of you, in the Grass Fields at about (-490, 2317), (-516, 2294) and (-541, 2294). That gives 180 ore/min.
- **Smelting:** 6 Smelters make 180 ingots/min.
- **Plates:** 6 Constructors make 120 Iron Plates/min.
- **RIP:** 4 Assemblers make about 20 RIP/min. They use your existing Screw output, tapped with a splitter.
- **Smart Plating:** 2 Assemblers make 4/min, fed from your Rotor stock. That clears the 50 in about 12 minutes of running.

**Leave your two impure nodes by the HUB alone.** They already feed your rod and screw lines.

**Power:** The new block should draw roughly 125 MW. That is well inside your headroom of about 500 MW. The estimate counts unfuelled Biomass Burners, so check they're fuelled before you rely on it.

After the Elevator, the RIP line carries on feeding Modular Frame and Heavy Modular Frame production.

When you finish, tell me what you enjoyed and what felt tedious. I'll shape the next order around that.
